profiles.name: Embedded Software Engineering (Industry)
profiles.text: Systems and Embedded Software Engineer with expertise in low-level systems programming, firmware development, and networking protocols. Seeking to design and optimize mission-critical, high-reliability embedded platforms while advancing modern computer architecture paradigms.

profiles.name: Academic & Higher Education (Lecturer in CSE)
profiles.text: Passionate educator and researcher dedicated to student mentorship and research-driven instruction. Seeking a faculty position to advance computing curricula, conduct systems research, and empower undergraduate engineering talent.

profiles.name: Hardware Systems & Processor Architecture (VLSI)
profiles.text: Hardware-software co-design enthusiast with hands-on experience in CPU architecture, instruction set simulation, and digital VLSI synthesis. Seeking to explore scalable silicon microarchitectures and specialized accelerator engines.

profiles.name: Human-Computer Interaction (HCI & Social Impact)
profiles.text: Human-centered computing advocate focused on bridging digital literacy divides through accessible user interfaces, contextual computing, and equitable technology access.
